gaps_remaining: 1986-1989: still empty of counts and still not a defensible zero. Ghana sat on the WHO IHR infected-area register throughout (Mfantsiman and Breman Asikuma in Central, Bole and West Gonja in Northern) with no removal notice filed after 1984, but the register froze in July 1986 and did not move for three years, which is the signature of an abandoned entry rather than of transmission. The 1987-89 zeros were kept and annotated; the 1986 zero stays retracted. Next step is Ashitey (1994) An Epidemiology of disease control in Ghana 1901-1990, print-only.
